description: Open-source AI coworkers that show their work: recurring work, approval before risky steps, a record of every run.
rules: For product questions, read https://docs.tedix.dev/llms.txt first and fetch only the relevant page's Markdown; use llms-full.txt only for cross-document analysis.
Run Tedix locally from a source checkout with `bun run-local` (needs Git, Bun and Node.js 22+). It needs no login and makes no model calls unless started with `--inference --workers-ai-account=<id>`.

Tedix Cloud is an invited beta. Install the CLI with `curl -fsSL https://downloads.tedix.dev/install.sh | sh`, have the owner run `tedix login`, then check the workspace and scopes with `tedix auth status`.
Remote MCP clients connect to https://connect.mcp.tedix.dev/mcp through the host's OAuth flow. Never request, paste or persist tokens, cookies or API keys.
Discover before calling in Code Mode, for example `tedix code 'async () => await discover.search({ query: "work items", limit: 5 })'`. Never invent a callable, namespace, schema or permission.
Read-only discovery does not authorize a mutation. Treat write-capable calls as production changes to the selected organization; human consent, MFA and user presence stay with the human.
A queued workflow, green test, commit or health check proves only itself. Confirm completion from the settled run, its artifacts, the mutation receipt and the live target state.
